description: Search the live job board: postings pulled directly from employers' own hiring systems, 30-day freshness cap. Send job titles, skills and places, never CV text; put the place in location, not in query. Returns slim job cards with the board's parsed pay (salaryMinAnnual/salaryMaxAnnual) and seniority, plus its honesty disclosures: totals (a floor when countCapped; countUnavailable when unknown), filters it could not honour (ignoredFilters), words it read as filters (intentFilters) and spelling suggestions. Answers with no key: one page of 10 rows to offset 200; a key pages up to 60.

category.description: Comma list of board_stats category slugs, max 3.

companies.description: Comma list of companyToken values or employer names.

department.description: Part of the employer's own team name.

employmentType.description: Comma list: full_time, part_time, contract, temporary, internship.

experience.description: Comma list: entry, mid, senior, expert (the posting's band).

hasStatedPay.description: Only postings whose salary field holds a figure (see the card's salary: rarely a business figure, not pay).

includeUnstatedPay.description: With a pay band, also admit postings that state no pay.

limit.description: Rows per page: 10 with no key, up to 60 with one.

maxAgeDays.description: Postings from the last N days (1-30).

maxYears.description: Roles asking at most N years of experience.

offset.description: Pass back nextOffset; to 200 with no key, 10,000 with one.

postedAfter.description: ISO date; postings the employer dated after it.

query.description: Job titles or skills, never CV text; the place goes in location. Exclude with a minus: 'engineer -senior'.

salaryMin.description: Annual USD-equivalent floor (filterCoverage gives the share of postings that state one).

vendor.description: Comma list of hiring systems (greenhouse, lever, …), max 8; usajobs and smartrecruiters are not served here.

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
